snippet.title: PATHOS: Mosh Pit Gameplay
snippet.description:
World 3 Level 5 -- Mosh Pit

»» BUY PATHOS: http://store.steampowered.com/app/679300/PATHOS/ 
»» Website: http://www.playpathos.com 
»» Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/PlayPathos
»» Twitter: http://twitter.com/Broguelike

PATHOS is an intricately crafted puzzle game with an intricately crafted narrative to match. Tap into your attentiveness, your logic, your creativity and your persistence to prevail through more than 150 puzzles, including some of the most devious ever seen in a Steam release, to keep a mind together that’s fraying at the ends. 

Who will be the first to conquer every Gordian Knot? Stat and progress tracking means someone will find their way to the top of the mountain first, or perhaps not. Perhaps PATHOS is unassailable. It’s up to the gifted puzzle crunchers out there to find out. 

PATHOS’ mesmerizing soundtrack provided by groove maestro Tim Halbert. It’s something you can move or sleep to. Whichever you prefer. 


Features:

- 150+ precisely crafted puzzles that wring every drop out of the developed mechanics.

- • Fully-voiced narrative that challenges and provokes.

- 30+ achievements, all of them discovered through deciphering verbal and visual clues.

- Several secrets woven even deeper into Pathos’ fabric.

- Powerful original soundtrack by Tim Halbert, with a definite earworm or two in there.

- Live, global win tracking statistics for every level.

 Minimum Requirements:
        OS: Windows XP SP2, Vista, or Windows 7
        Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core CPU
        Memory: 1 GB RAM
        Graphics: 256MB Graphics Card
        Storage: 250 MB available space
